scientific_scope: Poissonnier 2026 open-arena painted-trail response development only. No Y-maze access and no canonical promotion by this freeze.
mechanism_class: local bilateral tropotaxis on an externally painted undirected scalar trail field

external_field.source: published painted trail apparatus/protocol, never ant navigation state
external_field.line_directionality: undirected; swapping endpoints must not change the field

treatment_dose.pheromone: 0.0048 hindgut-equivalents/cm for the published nominal dose

external_field.distance_definition: Euclidean distance from sensor point p to the frozen undirected trail segment L
external_field.temporal_dynamics: stationary during an open-arena trial; no deposition, evaporation, diffusion, depletion, or ant-written field state in P1-v1
external_field.dose_semantics: A is an apparatus/protocol input. Treatment labels are not visible to the ant; only sampled scalar field values are.

egocentric_sensors.geometry_status: fixed engineering structure; not a fitted biological estimate

transduction.status: fixed deterministic saturating transduction; no fitted half-saturation or Hill exponent in P1-v1
properties: dose scaling enters only through the external scalar field

steering.update: while moving, sample both sensors at the pre-step position/heading and add omega_trail*dt to the same heading update that receives canonical angular noise
steering.sign_check: with heading east and the trail below the ant, the right sensor is closer to the trail, s_R>s_L, omega_trail>0, and positive ANTLAB rotation turns clockwise/downward toward the trail
steering.paused_intervals: no trail-induced heading drift while paused

future_response_parameters.bounds_status: not frozen here; must be frozen in a separate estimator policy before any parameter search
future_response_parameters.sharing_rule: one shared sigma_field_mm and one shared kappa_trail_per_s across short/long histories and all colonies

dcm_zero_signal.required_identity: trajectory and RNG state must be bit-for-bit identical to canonical locomotion for identical seed/configuration

zero_gain_nested_null.consequence: omega_trail=0 exactly even with nonzero pheromone field
zero_gain_nested_null.required_identity: trajectory and RNG state must be bit-for-bit identical to canonical locomotion for identical seed/configuration

structural_invariances: swapping trail segment endpoints leaves all field samples and trajectories unchanged
rigidly translating ant, arena, and trail together leaves body-frame sensor signals unchanged
rigidly rotating ant, arena, trail, and heading together leaves body-frame sensor signals and steering unchanged
reflection across the trail axis with reflected heading mirrors the steering sign
on-trail motion exactly parallel to the trail has s_L=s_R and zero deterministic trail steering
the mechanism has no preferred direction along the trail axis
short-versus-long approach history is not an input to the P1 mechanism
forbidden_inputs_and_shortcuts: canonical parameter changes conditioned on trail presence

engineering_reachability_values.status: frozen engineering values for reference-free reachability only; not biological estimates and not fitted to the response target

required_checks: DCM zero-dose identity is bit-for-bit canonical across a frozen seed panel
kappa=0 identity is bit-for-bit canonical across the same seed panel
no additional RNG draws or RNG streams
ant 10 mm above a horizontal trail and heading parallel to it has deterministic steering toward the trail
the reflected 10 mm-below case has equal-magnitude opposite-sign steering
on-trail parallel heading has exactly zero deterministic trail steering
trail endpoint reversal is exactly invariant
rigid translation and rotation tests pass to numerical tolerance
with frozen engineering values, a reference-free pooled pheromone-vs-zero-dose simulation shows a positive trail-axis attraction effect without changing canonical moving-speed dynamics
reference_free_reachability_requirements.engineering_outcome_rule: Reachability demonstrates mechanism wiring only. It is not evidence of biological fit and may not be used to choose estimator bounds after seeing reference outcomes.

implementation_gate.next_step: Implement P1-v1 exactly as frozen in an isolated runtime/model extension, add invariance and exact-null regressions, then run the frozen reference-free reachability panel. Do not load the 102-row response target during reachability.

failure_rule: If the first correctly implemented reference-free reachability panel fails a frozen structural requirement, do not tune P1-v1 engineering values after the fact. A genuine implementation bug may be corrected and rerun with this mechanism freeze unchanged.
